description: READ ONLY. The person’s own recent Piloxa letters, from any conversation, once this chat is connected with connect_my_letters. Optional query matches the recipient’s name or company, or the start of a Piloxa reference. Returns reference, recipient name, service, status, dates and where the status came from; never the letter text or full addresses. Without a connection it returns how to connect and nothing else.

query.description: Optional: a recipient name or company, or the start of a reference.

name: list_my_letters
